prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [144].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 144 格的答案。

options.text: Rate the red display as a whole, and leave out any comments about the size of the figures.
options.zh: 只給紅色顯示的整體評價，不用提數字大小。
options.whyZh: 只給整體評價，無法分辨是對字的尺寸有意見，還是對顏色有意見。

options.text: Let the volunteer count each comment about the red display as a vote for bigger figures.
options.zh: 請志工把每則對紅色顯示的評論，都計為支持大字顯示的一票。
options.whyZh: 這把顏色意見一律當成同一種對字體的投票；下句明確說要避免這種歸類。

options.text: If red is hard to see, report that the other display worked only if you switched to the smaller table clock.
options.zh: 如果紅色難讀，只有換用桌上的小字時鐘，才回報另一款顯示是否有用。
options.whyZh: 通知沒有規定必須先換成小字的時鐘才可回報，而且比較的是兩種大字顯示方案。

options.text: If the numbers are large enough but hard to see in red, say both things on the same comment.
options.zh: 如果字夠大、但變成紅色時不易看清，請在同一則留言中分別說明這兩點。
options.whyZh: 同一人可同時肯定大字的尺寸、指出紅色在此燈光下的可見度問題；這樣可區分兩項獨立意見。

explanationZh: 同一人可同時肯定大字的尺寸、指出紅色在此燈光下的可見度問題；這樣可區分兩項獨立意見。
evidence: find red figures hard to see under the hall lights / avoid treating a report about one color as a vote against large figures in general

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: find red figures hard to see under the hall lights
avoid treating a report about one color as a vote against large figures in general
